card.name: Inside long drug names
card.fires_on: Pieces partway through long, rare drug or chemical names, such as the zen in methyltriazen, ec in tetradecyl, am in carbamates, chn in pertechnetate, and van in vancomycin.

modes.label: Middle of chemical names
modes.description: Inner piece of a long chemical or salt name before the ending is complete.

modes.label: Start of vancomycin
modes.description: The opening piece of vancomycin, after a list or hyphen.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a long, unusual drug name that is still being spelled out.
